_note: 원문 유형은 글의 순서. order 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: Think of a moment when something suddenly startled you.
You probably froze, held your breath, and quickly scanned your surroundings for danger.
Such reactions help us avoid detection and prepare to fight or flee.
Because making any sound could reveal our position to a predator, freezing also silences us.
For this reason, intense stress and trauma tend to inhibit our ability to speak.
When the danger has passed, we relax and find our voices once more.
But some people live as if the threat never ends, trapped in constant fear.
Such lasting fear disrupts the development of neural networks and can lead to chronic stress and even mental illness.
choices: how the freeze response silences us and why chronic fear becomes harmful
why human language evolved more slowly than other animal signals
how predators use sound to locate and capture their prey
why laughter is the body's main defense against sudden danger
how regular exercise reduces the effects of everyday stress
theme.explanation_ko: 위협 시 소리를 내지 않으려 언어가 억제되는 '얼어붙는 반응'과, 그 공포가 만성화될 때의 해악을 다룬다. ①이 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ②언어 진화 속도, ③포식자의 소리 이용, ④웃음의 방어 기능, ⑤운동의 스트레스 감소는 핵심이 아니다.

passage: We should not dismiss the freeze response as a mere primitive reflex.
When startled, we stop, hold our breath, and silence ourselves to avoid being detected.
Because sound can betray our location, evolution wired us to fall silent under threat.
This is why deeply stressful or traumatic moments can rob us of speech.
Normally, once the danger passes, we relax and our voices return.
The real problem arises when a person can never feel safe again.
We must therefore take chronic fear seriously, since it disturbs neural development.
Left unaddressed, such lasting fear can produce chronic stress and even mental illness.
choices: 우리는 위협 앞에서 의도적으로 침묵하는 법을 배워야 한다.
만성적인 공포는 신경 발달을 해치므로 심각하게 다루어야 한다.
언어는 생존에 불리하므로 진화에서 사라져야 했다.
놀라는 반응은 훈련으로 완전히 없앨 수 있다.
스트레스는 인간의 창의성을 높이는 긍정적 요인이다.
claim.explanation_ko: 위협이 지나도 결코 안전을 느끼지 못하는 만성 공포가 신경 발달을 해쳐 만성 스트레스·정신 질환을 낳으므로 심각하게 다루어야 한다는 주장. ②.
claim.distractor_ko: ①의도적 침묵, ③언어 소멸, ④반응 제거, ⑤스트레스의 긍정성은 본문 주장과 다르다.

passage: A sudden fright makes us freeze, hold our breath, and look around for the source of danger.
These responses help us avoid detection and ready ourselves to fight or flee.
Since any sound might give away our location, the freeze response also suppresses speech.
That is why intense stress and trauma can inhibit our use of language.
Once the threat is gone, we relax and our voices come back.
Trouble begins when a person is never able to relax at all.
Living in constant fear interferes with the proper development of neural networks.
The result can be chronic stress and, in time, mental illness.
choices: 웃음은 위협에 대한 가장 효과적인 반응이다.
언어는 포식자를 쫓는 데 유용한 도구로 진화했다.
얼어붙는 반응은 언어를 억제하며, 공포가 만성화되면 신경 발달을 해친다.
사람은 위협을 느낄 때 항상 소리를 질러 도움을 청한다.
신체적 반응은 정신 건강과 아무런 관련이 없다.
gist.explanation_ko: 위협 시 소리를 막는 얼어붙는 반응이 언어를 억제하고, 그 공포가 만성화되면 신경 발달을 해친다는 것이 요지. ③.
gist.distractor_ko: ①웃음, ②언어의 사냥 도구화, ④소리 지름, ⑤무관함은 요지가 아니다.

passage: When something startles us, we instantly freeze and hold our breath.
This stillness helps us escape notice and prepare to react to danger.
Because a single sound could betray us to a predator, freezing keeps us silent.
So under great stress or trauma, our power of speech is held back.
When the threat passes, we relax and find our voices again.
Yet for some, the sense of threat never truly disappears.
Constant fear can interfere with the healthy growth of neural networks.
Over time, it may bring chronic stress and even mental illness.
choices: When Fear Silences Us: The Hidden Cost of Never Feeling Safe
How Language Helped Humans Conquer Their Predators
Laughter: The Body's Quickest Escape from Danger
Why Animals Make Noise When They Sense a Threat
The Evolution of Speech in Early Human Societies
title.explanation_ko: 공포가 언어를 침묵시키고, 안전을 느끼지 못하는 상태가 치르는 대가를 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②언어로 포식자 정복, ③웃음, ④동물의 소리, ⑤언어 진화는 초점이 아니다.

passage: A startle makes us freeze, hold our breath, and scan for the source of danger.
Because sound could reveal our location, the freeze response inhibits speech under threat.
Intense stress and trauma therefore tend to hold our language back.
Normally, when the threat passes, we relax and find our voices again.
But what if a person can never relax at all?
What if experience shapes the brain to stay in a constant state of fear?
Then the freeze rule, meant to protect us, never switches off.
Such ceaseless fear disturbs neural development and can cause chronic stress and mental illness.
implication.underlined: the freeze rule, meant to protect us, never switches off
choices: the protective response keeps firing even when no real danger exists
the brain permanently loses its ability to detect any threat
people deliberately choose to remain silent forever
predators can no longer locate their prey by sound
the body becomes immune to the effects of stress
implication.explanation_ko: '얼어붙는 규칙이 결코 꺼지지 않는다'는 것은 위험이 없어도 보호 반응이 계속 작동하여 만성 공포 상태에 머문다는 뜻이다. ①.
implication.distractor_ko: ②위협 탐지 능력 상실, ③영구적 침묵 선택, ④포식자 무력화, ⑤스트레스 면역은 모두 다르다.

passage: Think about a time when you were startled.
All these responses maximize our ability to avoid detection and prepare to fight or flee.
As sophisticated as language has become, it is still the creation of sound that might give away our location.
Because of this, the freeze response results in the inhibition of language in highly stressful situations.
When the threat passes, we begin to relax and find our voices again.
But what if our experiences shape our brain stayed in a constant state of fear?
This interference with the development of neural networks can result in chronic stress.
Such fear, left untreated, may even lead to mental illness.
grammar._grammar_note: ④ 'stayed' 가 비문법. 'shape our brain to stay ...' 처럼 'shape O to부정사' 구조여야 하므로 'to stay' 가 옳다.
grammar.explanation_ko: '경험이 우리 뇌를 ~한 상태에 있도록 형성한다'는 의미로 'shape our brain to stay' 가 되어야 한다. ④ 'stayed' 는 to부정사 'to stay' 로 고쳐야 하므로 ④가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 목적의 to부정사 to avoid, ② 양보 'As + 형용사 + as' 도치, ③ result in, ⑤ 조동사+동사원형 result in 은 모두 옳다.

passage: When startled, we freeze and hold our breath to avoid detection.
These responses maximize our ability to locate danger and prepare to fight or flee.
Because sound might give away our location to a predator, freezing keeps us quiet.
Thus the freeze response causes the inhibition of language in stressful, traumatic moments.
When the threat passes, we relax and recover our voices again.
But some people can never relax, living in a constant state of fear.
This promotes the proper development of neural networks.
The outcome can be chronic stress and even mental illness.
vocab._vocab_note: ⑤ 'promotes' 가 의도적 오답. 만성 공포는 신경망의 적절한 발달을 '방해(interferes with)'하므로 '촉진하다(promotes)'는 정반대이다.
vocab.explanation_ko: 만성 공포가 신경망의 올바른 발달을 '방해(interferes with)'한다는 맥락이므로 ⑤ 'promotes(촉진하다)'는 정반대의 낱말이다. ⑤가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①피하다 ②극대화하다 ③억제 ④회복하다는 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

passage: A startle makes us freeze, hold our breath, and scan for danger.
These reactions maximize our ability to avoid detection and prepare to fight or flee.
Because any sound could reveal our location to a predator, the freeze response inhibits language.
That is why deeply stressful and traumatic situations can rob us of speech.
When the threat passes, we relax and find our voices again.

blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 뒤 문장에서 '말(speech)을 빼앗는다'고 했고 소리가 위치를 드러내기 때문이라 했으므로 억제되는 것은 '언어(language)'이다.
blank.distractor_ko: ①움직임 ③기억 ④호흡 ⑤배고픔은 '소리가 위치를 드러낸다 → speech 상실' 단서와 맞지 않는다.

order.given: Think about a time when you were startled. Did you come to a sudden stop, freeze all your movements, and hold your breath as you scanned the environment for a threat? All these responses maximize our ability to avoid detection, locate the source of possible danger, and prepare to fight or flee.

blocks.A: But what if we can never relax? What if our experiences shape our brain to be in a constant state of fear? This interference with the proper development and integration of neural networks can result in chronic stress and even mental illness.
blocks.B: Because of this, the freeze response results in the inhibition of language in highly stressful and traumatic situations. When the threat passes, we begin to relax and find our voices again, perhaps even to laugh at our own reactions.
blocks.C: As sophisticated as language has become, it is still the creation of sound that might give away our location to a potential predator. Natural selection promoted the evolution of language but conserved the freeze rule.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 '얼어붙는 반응'을 (C)가 '소리가 위치를 드러낸다'로 이유를 설명하고, (B)가 'Because of this'로 언어 억제와 위협이 지나면 회복됨을 잇고, (A)가 'But ... 결코 못 쉰다면'으로 만성 공포의 해악으로 마무리한다. (C)-(B)-(A) = ⑤.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'Because of this'는 (C)의 소리 설명을 받으므로 첫 순서가 될 수 없고, (A)의 'But what if we can never relax?'는 (B)의 '위협이 지나면 회복' 다음에 와야 자연스럽다.

insert.insert_sentence: Because of this, the freeze response results in the inhibition of language in highly stressful and traumatic situations.

passage_marked.text: When we are startled, we freeze and hold our breath to maximize our ability to avoid detection.
As sophisticated as language has become, it is still the creation of sound that might give away our location to a predator.
When the threat passes, we begin to relax and find our voices again.
But what if we can never relax, our brain shaped to stay in a constant state of fear?
This interference with neural development can result in chronic stress and even mental illness.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'Because of this(이 때문에)'로 시작하므로 소리가 위치를 드러낸다는 ② 뒤에 와야 하고, 그 결과 위협이 지나면 목소리를 되찾는다는 ③으로 이어진다. ②가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ②에 넣지 않으면 'Because of this' 가 가리킬 '소리가 위치를 드러냄' 이라는 근거가 앞에 오지 않는다.

passage: When startled, we freeze and fall silent to avoid being detected.
Because sound could reveal our location, the freeze response inhibits language under threat.

Their brains stay locked in a constant state of fear.

summary.summary_template: The freeze response makes us fall __(A)__ to avoid predators, but when fear never lifts, it harms neural development and can lead to __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 얼어붙는 반응은 포식자를 피하려 (A)침묵(silent)하게 하지만, 공포가 사라지지 않으면 신경 발달을 해쳐 (B)정신 질환(mental illness)으로 이어진다. ①.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 asleep/louder 가 아니라 silent, (B)는 better memory/deep relaxation 이 아니라 mental illness 여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 위협이 지나가면, 우리는 긴장을 풀고 다시 목소리를 되찾기 시작한다.
writing.answer: When the threat passes, we begin to relax and find our voices again.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간 부사절 When the threat passes + 주절 begin to relax and find ...

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 모든 반응은 탐지를 피하는 우리의 능력을 극대화한다.
writing.answer: All these responses maximize our ability to avoid detection.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 All these responses + maximize + our ability + to부정사 to avoid detection.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 소리가 우리의 위치를 포식자에게 드러낼 수 있기 때문에, 얼어붙는 반응은 언어를 억제한다.
conditions: 이유를 나타내는 because of this 로 시작할 것
writing.answer: Because of this, the freeze response results in the inhibition of language.
writing.explanation_ko: Because of this + 주어 the freeze response + results in(~을 야기하다) + the inhibition of language.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: If our experiences shape the brain to stay in a constant state of ___________, neural development is disturbed and chronic stress may follow.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 뇌가 머무는 지속적 상태는 '공포(fear)'이며, 이것이 신경 발달을 해친다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: This interference with the proper development and integration of neural networks can result in chronic stress and even mental illness.
writing.answer: 신경망의 적절한 발달과 통합에 대한 이러한 방해는 만성 스트레스와 심지어 정신 질환을 초래할 수 있다.
writing.explanation_ko: interference with(~에 대한 방해), result in(~을 초래하다), even(심지어).
